entries.name: placeholderOpacity
notes: Declared by documentation page: UI 输入

The archived Player stores placeholderOpacity on the underlying UiInput renderable, but module 21031 exposes no public getter and module 93474 hardens the UiInput constructor, so delivered map scripts cannot add a compatible wrapper without replacing the historical runtime provider.

evidence.symbol: module 21031 UiInput wrapper and input focus events

entries.unavailableReason: The archived Player stores placeholderOpacity on the underlying UiInput renderable, but module 21031 exposes no public getter and module 93474 hardens the UiInput constructor, so delivered map scripts cannot add a compatible wrapper without replacing the historical runtime provider.
